import seaborn as sns

# Load the data

# Create a violin plot to compare the distribution of sleep duration across different age groups

sns.violinplot(x='Age', y='Sleep Duration', data=sleep_health)

plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')

plt.legend(title='Physical Activity Level')
